LanguageData.RT_M1A2_MainBattleTank.label: M1A2T Abrams
LanguageData.RT_M1A2_MainBattleTank.description:
Taiwanese export variant of the M1A2 Abrams with 120mm M256 gun, .50 BMG heavy MG, and coaxial M240 MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Loader x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 120mm M256 Gun: 120mm NATO (HE / APFSDS / Canister) - .50 Cal M2 Browning: .50 BMG cartridge (FMJ / AP / Incendiary / Sabot) - 7.62mm M240 MG: 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
